description: Sysco Corporation is the global leader in selling, marketing and distributing food and related products to customers who prepare meals away from home, including restaurants, healthcare and educational facilities, lodging establishments and entertainment venues. Founded in 1969, Sysco commenced operations as a public company in March 1970 when the stockholders of nine companies exchanged their stock for Sysco common stock, and since its formation it has grown from $115 million to an all-time high of $84.6 billion in annual sales in fiscal 2026, both through internal expansion of existing operations and acquisitions. Its fiscal year ends on the Saturday nearest to June 30th, and its foodservice operating sites distribute a full line of food products and a wide variety of non-food products to both independent and chain restaurant customers, hospitals, schools, hotels, industrial caterers and other venues where foodservice products are served, while SYGMA operating sites distribute to certain chain restaurant customer locations and its other business primarily comprises hotel supply operations, Guest Worldwide.
